summary:
Echoes in the Void is an interactive space expedition with a 2D indie-game style that turns space history into a playable, collectible adventure. Players discover, scan and collect 14 real NASA artifacts left behind in three zones: The Moon (Surveyor 1 and 3, Eagle, ALSEP, the Lunar Rover, Fallen Astronaut), Mars (Viking 1, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, InSight, Ingenuity) and Deep Space (Pioneer 10 and 11).

Orbitto, an animated chibi robot guide, narrates the original script in RPG-style dialogue boxes with a typewriter effect and voice, reacting with curiosity, awe and pride. Players scan each artifact, collect 14 badges, follow a live star map and travel through parallax backgrounds that change color by zone.

Our goal is to connect new generations with NASA’s real milestones and show that space history can feel as exciting as a video game.
details: The game is built in React with a mobile-first design, ready for official NASA images and web deployment. The team used ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini; Claude built the game itself.
